correctness.rationale: From exact RESULT.md: conditioning on different sides gives independent u,v uniform on [0,1] after affine reduction; the chord supporting line x/v+y/u=1 intersects the homothetic barycentric core iff a(1/u+1/v)<=1<=(1-2a)/min(u,v)+a/max(u,v), with a=(1-t)/3. The two disjoint failure areas are A=2a+2a^2 log((1-a)/a) and B=3a^2-2a(1-2a) log((1-a)/(1-2a)); integrating the regions gives Q=1-A-B. Same-side segments miss every proper core and give atom sigma. The perimeter weights satisfy 1/3<=sigma<1/2 by Cauchy, convexity and strict triangle inequalities. Independently integrated the two failure regions by numerical quadrature at five thresholds t=0.05,0.2,0.5,0.8,0.95, agreeing with the analytic closed form. The all-triangle result rests on exact integration, not Monte Carlo. Example side triples (2,2,1),(4,4,7) have equal sigma 9/25 and different shape.
residual_risks: Sampling measure is perimeter-uniform endpoints, not invariant lines; degeneracy only a limit and no universal polygon result.
